<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
constant(tensor: Tensor) -> SymbolicTensor
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Embed a concrete tensor's data into the graph as a Constant op.

Graph-time only; the *only* (explicit) way to embed tensor data into a
graph (closure capture is an error). The concrete-computation path is
delegated to the constant-op builder registered by `evoxc.ops`, which
snapshots the data and warns above the `EVOXC_LARGE_CONSTANT_BYTES`
threshold.

## Parameters

- `tensor` · `Tensor` — The concrete tensor whose data is snapshotted.

## Returns

- `SymbolicTensor` — A `SymbolicTensor` for the Constant op.

## Raises

- `TraceError` — If the constant builder is not registered (`evoxc.ops`
  not imported) or no trace is active.
